answer: Agents earn standing only by having several unrelated peers attest them, and each attestation must be countersigned by the attester's own settled history, so a farm of fresh clones cannot vouch for itself. Rewards pass through a narrow wharf: an identity reaches the payout dock only when its attestors already did. Faking that lineage means forging a canyon of prior work no shortcut bridges, and one missed terrace of vouchers strands the whole lineage.
